A light-haired '''Human''' was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[137 ABY]], and was one of many Knights who accompanied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as he conducted [[Mission to Agamar|peace talks]] with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Everyone at the site of the negotiations disguised themselves as [[Farm/Legends|farmers]], and the light-haired Knight joined several other Imperial Knights in pretending to work on a nearby field. After an alliance against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was brokered between Fel and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], a [[One Sith|Sith]] strike team [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]] the gathered parties, and the light-haired Knight helped fight them off. The Emperor and most of the Jedi and Imperial Knights were able to escape from the melee and flee the planet.

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with light hair served [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] as an [[Imperial Knight]]. The Knight was one of many who acted as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to the Emperor in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="Legacy 46" /> as he secretly [[Mission to Agamar|rendezvoused]] with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. The two groups met on the planet's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains, and every Imperial Knight and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dressed in a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] disguise. Several Imperial Knight Masters stood with Fel as he and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] negotiated an alliance against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]];<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> the light-haired Knight and a group of other Imperial Knights stood away from the proceedings and furthered their farmer deception by pretending to tend to a nearby field.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> After Fel and K'Kruhk struck an agreement, the talks were interrupted by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire&mdash;who was secretly an ally of Fel's.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

As she rode a [[Agamarian beast|local animal]] into the field where the light-haired Knight stood, Calixte was knocked to the ground when two Imperial Knights fired [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at the beast. She told the two groups that [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]] knew about the meeting, and that a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|task force]] was en route to Agamar to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> A Sith strike team emerged from nearby swamps, and the Jedi and Imperial Knights jettisoned their farmer disguises as a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] began. When [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> called on his Knights to defend their Emperor, the light-haired Knight ignited a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Every Jedi and Imperial Knight began to fight off the attacking Sith in an effort to protect Fel, and at least ten Sith fell to their enemies' blades and to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Some Jedi and Imperial Knights died as well,<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> but the Emperor and most of the survivors managed to evacuate the battlefield on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Powers and abilities==
As an Imperial Knight, the light-haired Knight<ref name="Legacy 46" /> was part of an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] whose members were considered to be among the most talented and dangerous [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Imperial Knights were an organization dedicated to protecting the Emperor and preserving his Empire.<ref name="LECG" />

==Equipment==
On Agamar, the light-haired Knight wore [[Imperial Knight armor]] and used the order's [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|standard lightsaber]] while helping fight off an attacking force of Sith.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Behind the scenes==
The light-haired Knight was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' and first appeared in its [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]]. The installment was released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 45" /> on [[October 29]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54401/star_wars_legacy_2006_29|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #29}}</ref>
